question: Malgudi Days is a collection of short stories by _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __RK Narayan.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Malgudi Days is a short story collection by R. K. Narayan.

 
 
• The book Malgudi Days contains 32 stories, all set in the fictional town of Malgudi.
 
• Google commemorated Narayan's 108th birthday by featuring a Google Doodle showing him behind a copy of Malgudi Days in 2018.
 
 
 
• R. K. Narayan was an Indian writer.
 
 
• He served as a member of Parliament Rajya Sabha from 1986 to 1992.
 
• He was honored with the Padma Vibhushan in 2001.
 
• Notable works:
 
 
• The Guide.
 
• Swami and Friends.
 
• The Bachelor of Arts.
 
• The Dark Room.
 
• The English Teacher.
 
• Mr. Sampath.
 
• Next Sunday.
 
• My Dateless Diary.
 
• My Days.
